decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (MR/1472/10a, MR/1472/1, MR/1472/2, MR/1472/3c, MR/1472/4b, received 11 July 2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north-western facing wall of the roof extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The east facing window in the existing garage shall be fixed shut and obscurely glazed before the development hereby approved is occupied and/or commenced and shall be permanently retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 1 Milnthorpe Road.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to link house and garage with alterations to the garage elevations.
